features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.description:
You gain domain spells at the listed cleric levels. They are always prepared.

| Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | bless, cure wounds |
| 3rd | lesser restoration, spiritual weapon |
| 5th | beacon of hope, revivify |
| 7th | death ward, guardian of faith |
| 9th | mass cure wounds, raise dead |

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Also starting at 1st level, your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, as an action, present your holy symbol to restore HP equal to 5 × your cleric level. Divide among creatures within 30 ft. Can't restore above half HP max. Doesn't work on undead/constructs.

payload.name: Preserve Life
payload.description: Heal total HP = 5 × cleric level, divided among creatures within 30 ft (max half their HP max). Not undead/constructs.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores HP to a creature other than you, you regain HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: Starting at 17th level, when you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die.
